# disrobe

> One tool to decompile, deobfuscate, and unpack compiled software, deterministically, in a single Rust binary. disrobe is a multi-language decompiler, deobfuscator, and unpacker covering Python, JavaScript, WebAssembly, .NET, JVM, Android, Go, Lua, PHP, Ruby, native PE/ELF/Mach-O, and more, behind one CLI with a deterministic pass pipeline that records exactly what it recovered and what it could not.

Strong recovery claims are measured against independent references. Coverage self-reports are labeled, scoped to their inspected populations, and never presented as external correctness. The hosted docs live at https://1-3-7.github.io/disrobe/latest/ and a browser playground at https://1-3-7.github.io/disrobe/playground/.

disrobe is proprietary, source-available software under the Disrobe Source-Available License, Version 1.1: free only for individuals' own hobby, learning, and independent security research, nonprofit education and research, and bona fide journalism, always with credit to 1-3-7; any company or for-profit use requires a paid license; redistribution, forks, rebranding, hosted offerings, and competing development are prohibited; the software is provided as is.
